scope: Exact first-line counts in preserved oracle-4 failed tool updates. Attempt counts are distinct case/repeat records with that error; categories overlap. These are descriptive observations, not causal attribution or new model runs. A task can have multiple errors or still pass.

matched_headlines.exact_text_mismatch: old_text must occur exactly once; read the exact current text
matched_headlines.stale_read: Read this file again: the read/hash is absent or stale
matched_headlines.plan_required: Save a short plan with remember(kind=plan) before editing
matched_headlines.repetition_block: This identical call failed three times. Change the plan or ask the user; it will not be repeated
